instruction: Create four local folders in Thunderbird: INBOX-BACKUP, SENT-BACKUP, DRAFTS-BACKUP, and TRASH-BACKUP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating four local folders in Thunderbird for backup purposes. Evaluator checks for all four folder files and their .msf metadata files. More complex variation requiring four folders instead of two.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for all four backup folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all 4 required folders (INBOX-BACKUP, SENT-BACKUP, DRAFTS-BACKUP, TRASH-BACKUP)
Correct state extraction: Postconfig uses 'ls -R' on the actual Thunderbird local folders directory where folders are created
Appropriate verification: Checks for both data files and .msf metadata files that Thunderbird creates for local folders
Logical flow correct: postconfig executes command -> getter reads cached output -> metric validates patterns
Regex patterns are functional: Despite complexity, the patterns will correctly match both the folder files and .msf metadata files
Minor complexity issue: Regex pattern '(?!\.msf)' negative lookahead is overly complex but semantically correct
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider simplifying regex patterns - could use simpler patterns like '\bINBOX-BACKUP\b' and '\bINBOX-BACKUP\.msf\b' instead of negative lookaheads
Current patterns work but are harder to maintain and understand
